description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for a configuration GUI application using Qt, including classes for configuration list, items, main window, and related components.

classes.name: ConfigSettings
classes.description: Subclass of QSettings for reading and writing configuration sizes.

classes.name: ConfigList
classes.description: Custom QTreeWidget for displaying configuration options with various modes and signals.

classes.name: ConfigItem
classes.description: Tree widget item representing individual configuration entries.

classes.name: ConfigItemDelegate
classes.description: Delegate for editing ConfigItem entries in views.

classes.name: ConfigInfoView
classes.description: Text browser widget showing detailed info about selected configuration items.

classes.name: ConfigSearchWindow
classes.description: Dialog window for searching within configuration items.

classes.name: ConfigMainWindow
classes.description: Main application window managing configuration display and interactions.

methods.name: findConfigItem
methods.description: Finds a configuration item based on menu structure.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets selection state for a list item.

methods.name: setRootMenu
methods.description: Sets the root menu for the list.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets value for a configuration item.

methods.name: changeValue
methods.description: Changes the value of a configuration item.
